text: Machine learning is a type of artificial intelligence that allows computers to learn from data without being directly programmed. In supervised learning, a computer is given training data, which includes examples with correct answers. The computer uses this data to build a model. A model is like a set of rules that helps the computer recognise patterns. After training, the model can make predictions about new information it has never seen before. For example, it can predict whether an email is spam or not. The quality of these predictions is measured by accuracy. The more training data a model receives, the better its accuracy usually becomes.
